digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI (+ Mgombato bundugo)

teaser.en: A wiry roadside weed whose name means 'extra strength', the strength that healers add to a person by unseen means.
teaser.sw: Gugu gumu kama waya la kando ya barabara ambalo jina lake linamaanisha 'nguvu za ziada', nguvu ambazo waganga humwongezea mtu kwa njia zisizoonekana.
teaser.dg: Mbondo nyifu ya kanda-kanda ya njira, ambayo dzinare rinagomba 'nguvu za kuenjerezwa', nguvu ambazo aganga nkumuenjereza mutu kpwa njira zisizoonekana.

summary.en: Mbundugo is a tough, small-flowered weed of the mallow family. It is used to give a person bundugo, the supplementary strength that Digo belief says can be added by a healer.
summary.sw: Mbundugo ni gugu gumu lenye maua madogo, la familia ya mibamia (mallow). Hutumika kumpa mtu *bundugo*, nguvu za nyongeza ambazo, kwa imani ya Kidigo, mganga anaweza kumwongezea.
summary.dg: *Mbundugo* ni mbondo ngumu ya jamii ya *mallow*, yenye maruwa madide. Nkuhumirwa kumpha mutu *bundugo*, nguvu za kuenjerezwa ambazo Adigo anaamini mganga anaweza kumuenjereza mutu.

about.en: Mbundugo is an erect, much-branched herb or small shrub, usually under a metre tall, with tough, fibrous, wiry stems. The leaves are narrow, lance-shaped, with toothed edges and short stalks. Small pale yellow flowers grow singly or in pairs in the leaf axils and open around midday. The fruit splits into several small segments, each tipped with two short beaks.
about.sw: Mbundugo ni mmea-shina laini uliosimama wima au kichaka kidogo chenye matawi mengi, kwa kawaida chini ya mita moja kwa urefu, wenye mashina magumu, yenye nyuzi na kama waya. Majani ni membamba, yenye umbo la mkuki, kingo zenye meno na vikonyo vifupi. Maua madogo ya manjano hafifu huota moja moja au mawili mawili kwenye kwapa za majani na huchanua karibu na adhuhuri. Tunda hupasuka kuwa vipande vidogo kadhaa, kila kimoja kikiwa na midomo miwili mifupi kwenye ncha.
about.dg: *Mbundugo* ni mmea mdide au chitsaka chidide, unaoima chocho na wenye panda nyinji, na mara nyinji taufika ure wa mita mwenga. Militaye ni migumu, ya nyuzi-nyuzi na mifu dza waya. Makodza ni membamba, ga umbo ra fumo, genye meno kanda-kanda na milita mifupi. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu ganamera mwenga-mwenga au mairi-mairi phatu kodza rinaphogbwirana na panda, na ganadzivugula namutsi. Tunda rinaganyika vipande vidide vinji, na chila chipande china ntsa mbiri fupi.

where.en: It is a common weed of roadsides, paths, compounds, fallow land and pasture throughout the tropics.
where.sw: Ni gugu la kawaida kando ya barabara, njia, viwanja vya nyumba, mashamba yaliyoachwa na malisho katika nchi zote za tropiki.
where.dg: Ni mbondo inayophahikana sana kosi tsi za dzoho, kanda-kanda ya njira, njira ndide, mihalani, minda iriyorichwa na phatu pha kurisira mifugo.

uses.en: Pakia records that it is used to give *bundugo*, extra strength added to a person by supernatural means. Elsewhere in the tropics the tough stems are tied into brooms.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba hutumika kumpa mtu *bundugo*, nguvu za ziada zinazoongezwa kwa mtu kwa njia zisizo za kawaida. Kwingineko katika nchi za tropiki mashina yake magumu hufungwa kutengeneza mafagio.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala nkuhumirwa kumpha mutu *bundugo*, nguvu za kuenjerezwa mutu kpwa njira zisizo za kawaida. Phatu phanjina kosi tsi za dzoho, militaye migumu nkufungbwa phamwenga kuhenda pyero.

culture.en: Pakia places *mbundugo* among names that announce the medicinal-magical result of using a plant, with *chimwemwe* ('smile'), *mvundza kondo* ('war terminator'), *phoza* ('heal') and *reza* ('neutralizer'). He explains *bundugo* as 'supplementary strength magically added to an individual'. Mgombato defines it as 'artificial strength given through witchcraft' and gives the expression *kurya bundugo*, 'to gain artificial strength'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaweka *mbundugo* miongoni mwa majina yanayotangaza matokeo ya kitiba na kiuchawi ya kutumia mmea, pamoja na *chimwemwe* ('tabasamu'), *mvundza kondo* ('mkomesha vita'), *phoza* ('ponya') na *reza* ('kiondoa nguvu'). Anaeleza *bundugo* kuwa 'nguvu za nyongeza zinazoongezwa kwa mtu kwa uchawi'. Mgombato analifafanua kuwa 'nguvu bandia zinazotolewa kwa uchawi' na anatoa msemo *kurya bundugo*, 'kupata nguvu bandia'.
culture.dg: Pakia anaika *mbundugo* kahi ya madzina ganayotangaza vira mmea unavyohenda uchihumirwa dza dawa au uganga, phamwenga na *chimwemwe* ('kutseka'), *mvundza kondo* ('chinachovundza kondo'), *phoza* ('phoza') na *reza* ('chinachousa nguvu'). Anaeleza *bundugo* kukala ni 'nguvu za kuenjerezwa mutu kpwa uganga'. Mgombato unaeleza dza 'nguvu za kuhewa kpwa utsai', na unapha maneno *kurya bundugo*, 'kuphaha nguvu za kuhewa kpwa utsai'.

names.en: Digo: *mbundugo*, 'spiritual strength'. Pakia records it only for Digo. In English it is known as common wireweed or broomweed.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbundugo*, 'nguvu za kiroho'. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu. Kwa Kiingereza unajulikana kama *common wireweed* au *broomweed*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mbundugo*, 'nguvu za chiroho'. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri kpwa Chidigo tu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *common wireweed* au *broomweed*.

reason.en: Abutilon, a relative in the mallow family
reason.sw: Abutilon, jamaa yake katika familia ya mibamia (mallow)
reason.dg: *Abutilon*, mmea wa phephi wa jamii ya *mallow*

reason.en: Another plant named for the outcome of using it
reason.sw: Mkimwemwe, mmea mwingine uliopewa jina kutokana na matokeo ya kuutumia
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wenye dzina rinarogomba vira unavyohenda uchihumirwa
*Phoza*, 'phoza', dzina ranjina ra vira mmea unavyohenda

reason.sw: Reza, 'kiondoa nguvu', jina jingine la matokeo
reason.dg: *Reza*, 'chinachousa nguvu', dzina ranjina ra vira mmea unavyohenda
